newsitem.title: USA: Fujisawa says court dismisses Kapoor suit.
newsitem.headline: Fujisawa says court dismisses Kapoor suit.

text.p: Fujisawa USA Inc, a unit of Japan's Fujisawa Pharmaceutical Co Ltd, said the Circuit Court of Cook County, Illinois on July 23 dismissed in its entirety a lawsuit brought against the company and certain officers and directors by John Kapoor.
In the lawsuit, Kapoor alleged that Fujisawa and its officers and directors had improperly initiated and prosecuted a federal lawsuit against him, Fujisawa said.

The federal lawsuit was filed by Fujisawa in August 1992 for alleged securities violations and racketeering claims tied to Fujisawa's 1989 purchase of Lyphomed Inc, a company then controlled by Kapoor, Fujisawa said.
